bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: Unclean shutdown detected. Integrity mismatch between the browser session cache and the system keyring. Tab restore and site sign-ins may fail until caches are reindexed and credentials resynchronized. No browsing data will be removed. Event ID: CHR-CACHE-217.
